question_variants: what is the establishment year of college
entries.answer_en: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC) was established in 1998 by the Indian School of Computer Science.
entries.answer_hi: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College ki sthapna 1998 mein Indian School of Computer Science dwara ki gayi thi.

question_variants: Which courses and degrees are offered at AKGEC
kaun kaun se courses hain college mein
what programs are available at AKGEC
B.Tech M.Tech MCA available hai kya
entries.answer_en: AKGEC offers four-year B.Tech degrees across major engineering disciplines, two-year M.Tech in four specialisations, and a two-year Master of Computer Applications (MCA).
entries.answer_hi: College mein sabhi pramukh branches mein 4 saal ka B.Tech, 4 branches mein 2 saal ka M.Tech, aur 2 saal ka MCA program chalaya jata hai.

question_variants: What is the sanctioned student intake capacity
college mein total kitni seats hain
how many seats are there in AKGEC
entries.answer_en: The approved sanctioned intake is 1,320 seats for B.Tech, 120 seats for MCA, and 72 seats for M.Tech across four departments.
entries.answer_hi: College mein B.Tech ke liye 1,320 seats, MCA ke liye 120 seats, aur M.Tech ke liye 72 seats sanctioned hain.

entries.answer_en: AKGEC is spread across a 40-acre campus situated at 27th Km Stone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway (NH-24), Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201015.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC 40 acre campus par sthit hai jo 27th Km Stone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway (NH-24), Ghaziabad, UP 201015 par hai.

question_variants: What are the administrative office hours
college office kab khulta aur band hota hai
when is the admin office open
entries.answer_en: The administrative office is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and on Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. It remains closed on Sundays and official holidays.
entries.answer_hi: Administrative office Monday se Friday subah 9:00 se shaam 5:00 tak aur Saturday ko subah 9:00 se dopahar 1:00 tak khula rehta hai.

question_variants: Who is the Director and Director General of the college
entries.answer_en: Dr. Hemant Ahuja is the Director of AKGEC, and Dr. R.K. Agarwal is the Director General.
entries.answer_hi: Dr. Hemant Ahuja AKGEC ke Director hain, aur Dr. R.K. Agarwal Director General hain.

question_variants: Which university is AKGEC affiliated with and what accreditations does it hold
is AKGEC approved by AICTE and NBA accredited
entries.answer_en: AKGEC is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU, Lucknow) under College Code 027, approved by AICTE, with major B.Tech disciplines accredited by NBA.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) se code 027 ke saath affiliated hai, AICTE se approved hai, aur pramukh B.Tech branches NBA accredited hain.

question_variants: How many books are in the central library
entries.answer_en: The central library is fully automated with over 1,00,000 books, national and international journals, and multimedia resources with smart RFID-card entrance access.
entries.answer_hi: Central library poori tarah automated hai aur usmein 1,00,000 se zyada books, national/international journals, aur smart RFID access uplabdh hai.

question_variants: Does the library have digital e-resources and database access
DELNET and NDL access in library
online journals library mein available hain kya
entries.answer_en: The library holds memberships of DELNET and the National Digital Library (NDL), and provides access to NPTEL, Coursera, edX, and IEEE e-resources.
entries.answer_hi: Library ke paas DELNET aur National Digital Library ki membership hai, jismein NPTEL, Coursera, edX aur IEEE databases access kar sakte hain.

question_variants: Are previous year question papers available in the library
previous year question papers library mein milte hain kya
model solutions and sessional paper bank
PUT papers bank in central library
entries.answer_en: Yes, the Central Library maintains a dedicated Question Papers and Model Solutions Bank containing previous sessional, Pre-University Test (PUT), and university exam papers.
entries.answer_hi: Central library mein previous sessional, Pre-University Test (PUT), aur university exams ke question papers aur model solutions ka bank rakha jata hai.

question_variants: Are there departmental and hostel libraries on campus
entries.answer_en: The library system includes nine departmental libraries and five hostel libraries managed with resources on loan from the Central Library.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC library network mein Central Library ke alawa nau departmental libraries aur paanch hostel libraries shamil hain.

question_variants: Is the campus Wi-Fi enabled and what are the computing facilities
how many computers are in the college
entries.answer_en: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled with high-speed broadband networking over 1,400 computers across academic labs, departments, and hostels.
entries.answer_hi: Campus poori tarah Wi-Fi enabled hai aur 1,400 se zyada computers broadband se connected hain.

question_variants: What Centres of Excellence and industrial training centres exist at AKGEC
robotics centre of excellence at AKGEC
entries.answer_en: AKGEC hosts 15+ industry-collaborated Centres of Excellence, including AKGEC-KUKA Industrial Robotics Training Centre, NI LabVIEW Academy, Siemens PLM, Bosch Rexroth Automation, and Janatics Pneumatics.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC mein 15 se zyada industry Centres of Excellence hain, jaise KUKA Robotics, NI LabVIEW, Siemens PLM, aur Bosch Rexroth.

entries.answer_en: AKGEC FabLab is an MIT-affiliated digital fabrication facility equipped with 3D printers, laser cutters, CNC tools, and prototyping hardware for student projects.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC FabLab MIT affiliated digital fabrication lab hai jismein 3D printers, laser cutters, aur rapid prototyping tools available hain.

question_variants: What student technical societies operate at AKGEC
Conatus CSI IEEE chapters kya hain
entries.answer_en: Active student technical societies include Conatus, Computer Society of India (CSI), IEEE Student Branch, SAE Collegiate Club, and Cloud Computing Cell.
entries.answer_hi: College mein active technical societies Conatus, CSI student chapter, IEEE, SAE, aur Cloud Computing Cell hain.

question_variants: What cultural and literary societies are active on campus
entries.answer_en: Campus cultural and creative societies include Oorja (dance, drama, music), Phoenix (arts and culture), Horizon (literary society), and Rotaract Club for community service.
entries.answer_hi: Cultural activities ke liye Oorja (dance, drama, music), Phoenix (arts), Horizon (literature), aur Rotaract club chalaye jaate hain.

question_variants: What sports and gymnasium facilities are available on campus
entries.answer_en: The campus includes a cricket pitch, football ground, basketball and tennis courts, badminton courts, table tennis, well-equipped gymnasiums, and hosts the annual sports fest Spardha.
entries.answer_hi: Campus mein cricket ground, football field, basketball court, badminton, table tennis, gym, aur annual sports fest Spardha hota hai.

question_variants: What is the campus placement track record of AKGEC
top recruiting companies and placement statistics
entries.answer_en: AKGEC consistently records over 2,000 placement offers from 213+ visiting companies annually, including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Amazon, and Capgemini.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC mein 2000 se zyada offers aur 213 se zyada recruiting companies aati hain jinmein TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon, aur Capgemini shamil hain.

question_variants: What is the minimum attendance requirement for semester exams
attendance kitni chahiye exam ke liye
entries.answer_en: A minimum of 75% attendance across all scheduled lectures and practical sessions is strictly required by AKTU and college regulations to appear in end-semester examinations.
entries.answer_hi: End-semester exams mein appear hone ke liye AKTU aur college norms ke mutabiq minimum 75% attendance hona anivarya hai.

question_variants: What is the campus anti-ragging policy and student safety framework
entries.answer_en: AKGEC enforces a strict zero-tolerance anti-ragging policy with 24x7 security, comprehensive CCTV surveillance, and a dedicated Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC mein ragging ke khilaf zero-tolerance policy hai jismein 24x7 security, CCTV surveillance, aur Anti-Ragging Squad sakriya rehte hain.

question_variants: How can I take admission in B.Tech at AKGEC
JEE Main rank se admission kaise hota hai
entries.answer_en: B.Tech admissions are conducted primarily through Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC) based on JEE Main merit ranks, alongside institutional quota seats per state norms.
entries.answer_hi: B.Tech admission JEE Main rank ke aadhar par UPTAC counselling ke through aur institutional quota seats par state norms ke mutabiq hota hai.

question_variants: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission
entries.answer_en: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects alongside Chemistry/Biotechnology/Computer Science, securing minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST).
entries.answer_hi: B.Tech ke liye candidate ko 10+2 mein Physics aur Mathematics ke saath minimum 45% marks (SC/ST ke liye 40%) prapt karna anivarya hai.

question_variants: Is there lateral entry admission to B.Tech 2nd year
lateral entry admission in B.Tech kaise hota hai
entries.answer_en: Candidates holding a 3-year Engineering Diploma or B.Sc degree with Mathematics are eligible for lateral entry admission directly into the 2nd year (3rd semester) via UPTAC counselling.
entries.answer_hi: 3-year Engineering Diploma ya Mathematics ke saath B.Sc pass candidates UPTAC lateral entry counselling ke through 2nd year mein direct admission le sakte hain.

question_variants: How can I take admission in MCA at AKGEC
entries.answer_en: MCA admissions are based on CUET-PG scores. Eligibility requires BCA or graduation with Mathematics at 10+2 or degree level with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST).
entries.answer_hi: MCA admission CUET-PG rank se hota hai. Candidate ke paas BCA ya graduation mein 50% marks (SC/ST 45%) aur Mathematics hona anivarya hai.

question_variants: How can I take admission in M.Tech at AKGEC
entries.answer_en: M.Tech admissions require a B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST), evaluated through valid GATE scores or CUET-PG.
entries.answer_hi: M.Tech ke liye relevant branch mein B.Tech (minimum 50% marks, SC/ST 45%) aur valid GATE ya CUET-PG score aavashyak hai.

question_variants: What meritorious scholarships are available for B.Tech and MCA
entries.answer_en: Students with JEE Main AIR up to 25,000 for B.Tech, or CUET-PG AIR 1-750 for MCA, receive college merit scholarships, renewable upon maintaining 90% attendance and CGPA 7.5+ with no backlogs.
entries.answer_hi: JEE Main AIR 25,000 tak ke B.Tech students aur CUET-PG AIR 1-750 ke MCA students ko merit scholarship milti hai, jo 90% attendance aur 7.5+ CGPA par renew hoti hai.

question_variants: Is there a tuition fee scholarship for M.Tech students
entries.answer_en: M.Tech candidates securing 65% aggregate in B.Tech receive approx Rs 25,000 waiver, 70%+ receive 50% tuition waiver, and 75%+ receive 75% waiver, with a 5% relaxation for AKGEC alumni.
entries.answer_hi: M.Tech mein B.Tech 65% marks par Rs 25,000, 70% par 50% tuition waiver, aur 75% par 75% waiver milta hai (alumni ko 5% aggregate chhoot).

question_variants: How can I apply for UP Government Post-Matric Scholarship
UP scholarship Samaj Kalyan form kaise bharein
scholarship form for SC ST OBC students
entries.answer_en: Eligible SC, ST, OBC, General, and EWS students can apply for the UP Government Post-Matric Scholarship via scholarship.up.gov.in and submit verified printouts to the College Registrar office.
entries.answer_hi: Eligible students UP Government ke scholarship.up.gov.in portal par apply karke verified hard copies College Registrar office mein submit karein.

question_variants: How can students pay the college fee
can I pay fees by NEFT RTGS or Demand Draft
entries.answer_en: Fees can be paid online through the college ERP fee portal (net banking, debit/credit cards), via NEFT/RTGS bank transfer, or by Demand Draft in favour of 'Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College' payable at Ghaziabad or Delhi.
entries.answer_hi: Fees online ERP portal se, NEFT/RTGS bank transfer se, ya 'Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College' ke naam bane Demand Draft se bhari ja sakti hai.

question_variants: What details should be written on the demand draft for fee payment
DD ke peeche kya likhna hota hai
entries.answer_en: Write the student's full name, roll number or application number, branch, and contact mobile number on the back of the draft. It can be submitted at the accounts counter or sent by registered post.
entries.answer_hi: Demand Draft ke peeche apna naam, roll number, branch, aur mobile number likhein; use accounts counter par ya registered post se submit karein.

question_variants: Is the counselling amount adjusted in college fees
counselling deposit fees mein adjust hoga kya
counselling fee deduction from total fee
entries.answer_en: Yes, the full seat acceptance fee deposited during UPTAC counselling is credited and deducted from the candidate's total first-year college fee.
entries.answer_hi: Haan, UPTAC counselling ke samay jama ki gayi seat acceptance fee total first-year college fee mein se ghata di jaati hai.

question_variants: What is the late fee fine for overdue semester fees
late fee fine kitni lagti hai
entries.answer_en: A late fine of Rs 100 per day applies on semester fee dues after the notified deadline, up to a maximum period of 15 days.
entries.answer_hi: Notified due date nikalne ke baad 100 rupaye roz ka late fine lagta hai, 15 din tak.

question_variants: Is the caution money refundable and how much is it
caution money kab wapas milti hai
entries.answer_en: The caution money of Rs 5,000 paid at admission is a refundable security deposit, returned to the student upon course completion and submission of the no-dues clearance.
entries.answer_hi: Admission ke samay li gayi 5,000 rupaye ki caution money course complete hone aur no-dues clearance ke baad refundable hoti hai.

question_variants: What benefits are covered under medical charges in the fee
medical insurance cover in college fee
medical charge mein kya facilities milti hain
entries.answer_en: Annual medical charges cover hospitalisation insurance up to Rs 50,000, personal accident insurance up to Rs 1,00,000, and free annual OPD consultations at Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
entries.answer_hi: Medical charges mein 50,000 rupaye tak ka hospitalization insurance, 1,00,000 tak ka accidental cover, aur Dr. R.S.G. Hospital mein free annual OPD checkup shamil hai.

question_variants: Do students pay university exam fee to AKGEC or AKTU
exam fee kisko pay karni hoti hai
entries.answer_en: The university examination fee and digital consortium fee are collected directly by AKTU via the AKTU ERP student portal as per university notification.
entries.answer_hi: University examination fee aur digital library fee seedhe AKTU dwara unke official portal par li jaati hai.

question_variants: Where can I get the fee receipt after payment
payment receipt for education loan or tax
entries.answer_en: Fee receipts are generated digitally on the college ERP portal under Fee Payment within one working day of payment clearance, suitable for tax and education loan claims.
entries.answer_hi: Fee receipts payment clearance ke baad ek working day mein college ERP portal par Fee Payment section se download ki ja sakti hain.

question_variants: Can the college fee structure change during the course
fee structure badal sakta hai kya
is the college fee fixed for 4 years
entries.answer_en: The fee structure is subject to revision as determined periodically by the Uttar Pradesh State Government Fee Fixation Committee for private engineering institutions.
entries.answer_hi: College fee structure UP State Government Fee Fixation Committee dwara badla ja sakta hai.

question_variants: When are AKTU semester end examinations conducted
odd and even semester exam dates
end semester exam schedule in AKTU
entries.answer_en: Odd semester theory examinations are typically conducted in December-January, and even semester examinations in May-June, as notified on the official AKTU academic calendar.
entries.answer_hi: Odd semester ke exams December-January mein aur even semester ke exams May-June mein AKTU calendar ke anusaar hote hain.

question_variants: What are internal sessional tests and PUT examinations
Pre-University Test PUT kya hota hai
entries.answer_en: The college conducts two internal sessional exams and one comprehensive Pre-University Test (PUT) per semester to evaluate continuous internal assessment marks.
entries.answer_hi: Continuous internal assessment ke liye har semester do sessional tests aur ek Pre-University Test (PUT) karwaya jata hai.

question_variants: Where and when can students download their exam admit card
hall ticket download for semester exams
entries.answer_en: Admit cards are published on the AKTU ERP student portal approximately three days prior to the commencement of the first theory examination.
entries.answer_hi: Admit card pehle theory exam se lagbhag teen din pehle AKTU ERP portal par download ke liye uplabdh hota hai.

question_variants: Where is the examination seating plan displayed
hall seating arrangement on exam day
entries.answer_en: The daily exam seating plan is displayed on notice boards of respective academic blocks and published on the college ERP portal one day before each exam.
entries.answer_hi: Exam room aur seating plan har block ke notice board aur ERP portal par exam se ek din pehle lagaya jata hai.

question_variants: How can a student apply for answer sheet re-evaluation or scrutiny
entries.answer_en: Students can apply for challenge evaluation or scrutiny online through the AKTU ERP portal within 7 to 15 days of result declaration upon paying the prescribed university fee.
entries.answer_hi: Result aane ke 7 se 15 din ke andar AKTU ERP portal par prescribed fee ke saath challenge evaluation ya scrutiny ke liye apply kar sakte hain.

question_variants: What are the rules for back paper and carry-over examinations
back paper kab de sakte hain
carry over examination rules kya hain
entries.answer_en: Carry-over examinations (back papers) for odd semesters are held alongside regular odd semester exams, and even semester carry-overs alongside regular even semester exams.
entries.answer_hi: Odd semester ki back paper odd semester exams ke saath aur even semester ki carry-over even semester exams ke saath di ja sakti hai.

question_variants: How do graduating students collect provisional degree and final transcript
entries.answer_en: Provisional degree certificates and consolidated grade cards are issued by the College Registrar office after final semester result clearance and submission of the no-dues slip.
entries.answer_hi: Provisional degree aur marksheet final result clearance aur no-dues slip submit karne ke baad College Registrar office se milti hai.

question_variants: How many hostels are on campus and what is the total capacity
entries.answer_en: The college provides six hostels spread over four complexes: Junior Boys, Senior Boys, Junior Girls, and Girls Complex, accommodating over 1,500 students.
entries.answer_hi: College mein 6 hostels hain jo 4 complexes mein hain: Junior Boys, Senior Boys, Junior Girls, aur Girls complex, jinmein 1,500 se zyada students reh sakte hain.

question_variants: Where do first year boys stay
first year hostel separate hai kya
entries.answer_en: First-year boys stay in the dedicated Junior Boys Hostel complex in double occupancy rooms, ensuring a secure and ragging-free environment.
entries.answer_hi: First-year boys Junior Boys Hostel complex mein double-seater rooms mein rehte hain jo bilkul ragging-free aur secure environment deta hai.

question_variants: What are the accommodation facilities for girls
entries.answer_en: Female students are accommodated across three secure girls' hostels featuring double and triple seater rooms with an intake of approximately 600 students.
entries.answer_hi: Chhatraon ke liye teen surakshit girls hostels hain jinmein double aur triple seater rooms hain aur lagbhag 600 students reh sakte hain.

question_variants: What time do hostel gates close
hostel kitne baje band hota hai
entry deadline at night for hostellers
entries.answer_en: Hostel gates close strictly at 10:00 PM on weekdays (Monday to Friday) and at 11:00 PM on weekends (Saturday and Sunday).
entries.answer_hi: Hostel gate weekdays mein raat 10:00 baje aur weekend par 11:00 baje band hota hai.

question_variants: What are mess timings for breakfast lunch and dinner
khana kab milta hai hostel mein
breakfast lunch dinner schedule in hostel
entries.answer_en: Mess timings are: Breakfast from 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM, Lunch from 12:30 PM to 2:00 PM, and Dinner from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM.
entries.answer_hi: Mess ka time hai: Breakfast subah 7:30 se 9:00, Lunch dopahar 12:30 se 2:00, aur Dinner raat 7:30 se 9:00 baje tak.

question_variants: Is hot water and Wi-Fi available in hostels
garam paani milta hai kya hostel mein
entries.answer_en: All 6 hostels are equipped with solar water heaters for hot water supply, high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity, TV lounges, canteen stores, and gymnasiums.
entries.answer_hi: Sabhi 6 hostels mein garam paani ke liye solar water heaters lage hain, high-speed Wi-Fi, TV lounge, canteen, aur gym uplabdh hain.

question_variants: How can a student request a hostel room change
hostel room change procedure kya hai
changing roommate or room in hostel
entries.answer_en: Room change requests must be submitted using Form H-4 at the Chief Warden office within 7 days of room allotment, subject to mutual agreement and room availability.
entries.answer_hi: Room change ke liye Form H-4 allotment ke 7 din ke andar Chief Warden office mein jama karein.

question_variants: What is the procedure for night leave or outpass from hostel
hostel se bahar jane ki permission
entries.answer_en: Hostelers must apply for night leave through the online warden portal with verified parental consent via registered contact at least 24 hours prior to departure.
entries.answer_hi: Hostel se bahar raat rukne ke liye parent verification ke saath 24 ghante pehle online portal par warden permission lena anivarya hai.

question_variants: Does the college provide bus service and which routes are covered
college bus service routes kya hain
transport facility routes for day scholars
entries.answer_en: AKGEC runs a fleet of college buses covering extensive routes across Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, Anand Vihar, and Dilshad Garden for day scholars.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, aur Anand Vihar ke sabhi mukhya routes par college bus service chalata hai.

question_variants: How can students apply for a bus pass and pay transport fees
entries.answer_en: Students apply for bus passes through the Transport Coordinator desk by submitting the route registration form and paying transport fees for the semester or academic year.
entries.answer_hi: Bus pass lene ke liye Transport Coordinator desk par route registration form submit karke semester ya annual transport fee bharein.

question_variants: What are college bus arrival and departure timings
bus subah kab aati hai aur shaam ko kab nikalti hai
entries.answer_en: College buses reach the campus by 8:30 AM in the morning and depart from the campus bus bay at 5:10 PM on all working days.
entries.answer_hi: College buses subah 8:30 baje tak campus pahunchti hain aur working days par shaam ko 5:10 baje campus se nikalti hain.

question_variants: What medical emergency and ambulance facilities are on campus
campus dispensary and doctor on call
entries.answer_en: AKGEC maintains an on-campus medical dispensary with visiting medical officers, nursing staff, and a dedicated 24x7 ambulance tied to Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
entries.answer_hi: AKGEC campus mein doctor aur nursing staff ke saath dispensary hai aur Dr. R.S.G. Hospital se connected 24x7 ambulance seva uplabdh hai.

question_variants: What is the emergency helpline and security protocol
entries.answer_en: For immediate campus emergencies, contact the 24x7 Campus Security Control Room at the Main Gate or dial police helpline 112 for external emergency response.
entries.answer_hi: Kisi bhi emergency mein Main Gate sthit 24x7 Security Control Room se sampark karein ya external emergency ke liye 112 dial karein.
